Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4419170. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by chembl_id, and finally to compound_structures as an inner join to ensure canonical SMILES are available. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
